labs.name: lan-rooms
labs.title: Share with people on the same Wi-Fi
labs.description: Let colleagues on the office Wi-Fi browse a hardened copy of a site, signed in as a user you choose.
labs.warning: Asks for your password once to install a firewall rule, and opens port 8443 on this Mac while a share is on. A share stays up until you stop it.

labs.name: quick-switch
labs.title: Quick Switch panel
labs.description: A panel on a global keyboard shortcut to open a site as any pinned user.
labs.warning: Holds a system wide keyboard shortcut while the app runs.

labs.name: example-linux
labs.title: An experiment that runs on Linux
labs.description: A recorded entry for a lab that lists linux, so it is available in WSL.
